_comment: Editable assumptions for Step 8. kind=ASSUMPTION means invented placeholder; MEASURED_ON_SYNTHETIC means our own result on synthetic data. Neither is real upay data. Edit values here, then run: python src/impact_model.py

assumptions.name: Monthly transactions scored by ScamShield (in-scope P2P sends)
assumptions.basis: Placeholder, held equal across scenarios so scenarios isolate model and cost effects. Replace with upay's real monthly P2P send count.

assumptions.name: Scam rate (share of scored transactions that are loss-causing scams)
assumptions.basis: NOT the 2.9% of our synthetic data (that is injected by construction). Real rates are far lower; bad = 0.01%, medium = 0.03%, good = 0.06% are placeholders.

assumptions.name: Average loss per scam transaction
assumptions.basis: Placeholder. Compute the average P2P ticket from Bangladesh Bank MFS tables (value / number) and compare with victim-reported losses.

assumptions.name: Recall (share of scam transactions flagged)
assumptions.basis: Our own Step 3 numbers on synthetic data: good = Step 2 test split (85.9%), medium = 'Evasion, known scams adapted' (44.7%), bad = 'External validation, all shifts' (18.0%). Real-world recall is unknown.

assumptions.name: Intervention success (share of flagged scams where the warning/hold really stops the loss)
assumptions.basis: Not measured. Customer may ignore a warning; scammer may re-route. Set it to 100% to get the literal 'volume x rate x loss x recall' formula.

assumptions.name: False-alarm rate (share of legitimate transactions flagged)
assumptions.basis: Own Step 3 numbers: good = Step 2 test split (1.95%), medium = Evasion row (2.24%), bad = External validation (6.77%).

assumptions.name: Share of flags reviewed by a human analyst
assumptions.basis: Design rule of the prototype (HIGH cases go to an analyst). Lowering it models triage, but then check the intervention success input.

assumptions.name: Review time per flagged case
assumptions.basis: Placeholder. Time a real analyst on 30-50 cases during the pilot.

assumptions.name: Fully loaded monthly cost of one analyst
assumptions.basis: Placeholder. Use upay HR figure; public check: job-portal salary surveys and BBS wage statistics.

assumptions.name: Paid hours per analyst per month
assumptions.basis: 22 working days x 8 hours.

assumptions.name: Productive share of paid time (utilization)
assumptions.basis: Placeholder; breaks, meetings, idle time between cases.

assumptions.name: Notification cost per flag (SMS / push)
assumptions.basis: Placeholder; replace with upay's SMS gateway cost.

assumptions.name: Share of false alarms that contact customer support
assumptions.basis: Placeholder; measure in the pilot from call-centre tags.

assumptions.name: Cost of one support contact
assumptions.basis: Placeholder; use upay call-centre cost per contact.

assumptions.name: Abandonment rate after a false alarm (customer cancels the transfer)
assumptions.basis: Placeholder; measure in the pilot (cancelled / warned legitimate transfers).

assumptions.name: Revenue lost per abandoned transaction
assumptions.basis: Placeholder; use upay's send-money fee / margin per transaction.

assumptions.name: Churn probability per false alarm
assumptions.basis: Placeholder; measure by comparing 90-day retention of warned vs unwarned legitimate customers.

assumptions.name: Annual margin of an active customer
assumptions.basis: Placeholder; use upay's ARPU/margin.

assumptions.name: One-time cost (build, integration, security review, training)
assumptions.basis: Placeholder, no upay quote exists.

assumptions.name: Monthly run cost (hosting, monitoring, retraining, support)
assumptions.basis: Placeholder.

assumptions.name: ROI horizon
assumptions.basis: Chosen by the team; ROI = (net benefit x horizon - one-time cost) / one-time cost.

S1.title: Bangladesh Bank, Mobile Financial Services (MFS) Statistics: Transaction Statistics
S1.use: Industry transaction counts and values; derive average ticket size and a plausible upay share. Monthly counts are in the hundreds of millions industry-wide.

S2.title: upay / UCB annual report and Bangladesh Bank MFS provider-wise statistics
S2.use: Upay's own volume, active customers, revenue. Prefer the company's own internal figure.

S3.title: Bangladesh Financial Intelligence Unit (BFIU) annual report
S3.use: Suspicious-transaction reports and typologies involving MFS; verify the current edition.

S4.title: Bangladesh Police / CID cyber-crime statistics and the National Cyber Security Agency
S4.use: Reported MFS-related fraud cases and losses; reported cases understate true incidence.

S5.title: UK Finance, Annual Fraud Report (authorised push payment scams)
S5.use: International benchmark for APP-scam counts, values and share recovered; use only as a cross-check, not as a Bangladesh figure.

S6.title: GSMA, State of the Industry Report on Mobile Money
S6.use: Mobile-money fraud and consumer-protection context across markets.

S7.title: This project: results/step2_main_results.csv, results/step3_scenarios.csv, models/metrics.json
S7.use: Recall and false-alarm rate. Synthetic data; say so whenever you cite them.

S8.title: UK Payment Systems Regulator, APP scams performance data
S8.use: Share of APP-scam losses recovered or reimbursed; indicates how often a flagged payment can really be stopped.

S9.title: Your own pilot measurements (time-and-motion study, call-centre tags, cancellation logs, retention)
S9.use: The only credible source for analyst minutes, support contacts, abandonment and churn.

S10.title: Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics (BBS) wage and labour statistics; job-portal salary surveys
S10.use: Salary level for analysts and call-centre staff; cross-check against upay HR.

S11.title: Bangladesh Bank, Monthly Economic Trends / interest-rate statistics
S11.use: Cost of funds for idle-cash valuation (Agent Copilot calculator).

S12.title: BTRC (telecom regulator) SMS tariff / your SMS gateway invoice

S13.title: upay official tariff page / app charges and Bangladesh Bank circulars on MFS charges
S13.use: Send-money and cash-out fee schedule. A news report states Bangladesh Bank sets no fixed cash-out cap, so the provider's own tariff is the authority.

S14.title: Helix Institute of Digital Finance / InterMedia agent-network surveys (Bangladesh)
S14.use: Agent liquidity problems, stock-out frequency, agent commission levels.

S15.title: Kohavi, Tang, Xu, Trustworthy Online Controlled Experiments (Cambridge University Press, 2020)
S15.use: A/B test design, sample size, guardrail metrics.

S16.title: Duflo, Glennerster, Kremer, Using Randomization in Development Economics Research: A Toolkit (2007)

S17.title: Deng, Xu, Kohavi, Walker, Improving the Sensitivity of Online Controlled Experiments by Utilizing Pre-Experiment Data (CUPED, WSDM 2013)

ab_pilot.name: Significance level alpha (two-sided)
ab_pilot.basis: Standard experiment convention; change only if the team pre-registers a different value.

ab_pilot.name: Std. deviation of fees paid per eligible customer-month
ab_pilot.basis: Computed on our synthetic data (std of monthly fee on cash-outs under BDT 1,500, using the ASSUMED 1.4% rate). Replace with the std from 8-12 weeks of real pre-period data.

ab_pilot.name: Minimum detectable effect (saving per customer-month)
ab_pilot.basis: Smallest saving worth acting on. Choose with the business team; smaller MDE needs many more customers.

ab_pilot.name: Correlation between pre-period and pilot-period fees (for CUPED)
ab_pilot.basis: Measure on real pre-period data. Set to 0 to disable variance reduction.

ab_pilot.name: Expected attrition / missing data
ab_pilot.basis: Customers who become inactive or unreachable during the pilot.

ab_pilot.name: Eligible customer base available for the pilot
ab_pilot.basis: Replace with the real count of customers having at least 2 small cash-outs in the pre-period.

ab_pilot.name: Pilot duration
ab_pilot.basis: At least two salary-week cycles; cash-out behaviour is strongly calendar-dependent.

ab_pilot.name: Cash-out fee rate (customer pays at agent)
ab_pilot.basis: Same prototype assumption as src/cashout_saver.py; a 2021 press report quoted upay at 1.4% for USSD agent cash-out. NOT confirmed as the current tariff.

ab_pilot.name: Customer fee on the digital alternative (merchant payment)
ab_pilot.basis: Merchant payments are often free to the payer; check the tariff.

ab_pilot.name: Merchant discount rate earned by upay on migrated value
Small cash-out limit defining eligible cash-outs
